mechanics.text: Start on the edge and tank Vale there. After the first split, return to the same edge spot and dodge one rotating sector. After the second split, move closer to center and dodge two rotating sectors.
Split phase: condition DPS to red guardian; others pull green guardian to blue guardian; dont cross back over to friends til all adds dead
Blue circles with red outlines (Unstable Magic Spike): Move out - it'll teleport you. A yellow border also appears around your screen if you're in it.
Green circles (Distributed Magic): four players soak or prepare to heal through
Red Balls (Seekers): knockback/pull away from group
Capture rifts - stand in red circles to catch falling orbs
Race: clear mobs, kill walls, and close rifts on the run
Cemetery: five players stand on five buttons simultaneously
Stand behind boss; dodge slam knockback (Spectral Impact)
Break defiance bar when up (Ghastly Rampage) and avoid black puddles
If DPS is slow, he'll cast World Eater - break the walls and glide outside the arena to avoid
Split phase: kill/slow/immobilize Charged Souls before they reach boss
At 33% and below: sidestep orange AOE (Eggs) under feet; free trapped allies by killing cages
Someone needs to stand far from group to bait lava puddles (Flak Shot)
Use special action key (Sapper Bomb) on launch pad friends so they can kill cannons
Red circle around player (TIme Bomb): move away before explosion
Big arrow from Sabetha (Flame wall): stand behind arrow and follow it
Kick Heavy Bombs off the platform using the interact key
Mini-bosses at 75/50/25% - kill quickly and break CC
Assign four players to eat Blue Poison Mushrooms to clear poison areas
Fixate rotates every 30s - purple diamond on head of tank, move boss to cleared area
3 blue circles spawn under player (Tantrum): stop moving till all spawn; dodge the final knockdown
Green skull (Volatile Poison): drop puddle away from group at nearest wall
Boss stops all movement and shimmies (Shake): dodge away, pause, dodge back
Pull in and kill slubling adds without hitting your transformed allies
Narcolepsy: at 80/60/40/20% Slothasor falls asleep. Break his defiance bar to end the CC and be ready with stability or stunbreaks - he always fears the squad when he wakes regardless of break speed
Protect prisoners. Mortars spawn around 5:05, 6:10 and 7:15 - assign a player to bounce outside via the launch pad, break the Bombardier's defiance bar, then return to the camp for heals
Watch for saboteurs marked by red swords on the minimap. They plant bombs if not stopped - players with Nuhoch Stealth Detection must find and break their bar or kill them before they finish
Bring beehives to east wall, oil kegs to the grassy overlook with warg cages
Berg: throw beehives; don't face his cone at the cage
Zane teleports to the furthest player and drops a blind field. Stack away from the cage so he doesn't port onto it, sidestep his cone shots and free wargs to help kill him
Narella: avoid tornadoes; throw oil kegs
Boss gets bubble (Blood Shield): Reflect projectiles to break his shield - don't break projectiles with abilities or body
Boss leaps in air and launches shards (Shards of rage): Don't reflect these to the boss or he gets powered up
Cleanse red circle (Corruption) at an non-red fountain if you get it
Red arrow over player (Blood Sacrifice): break their CC bar quickly, try not to DPS them
100%-80% (Snowstorm): Dodge staff spin attack ("Hadouken")
80%-60% (Heatwave): Keep moving, If you get green skull (Unstable Blood Magic) drop it at the wall with special action button, but not at fountains
60%-40% (Downpour) don't move unless you need to spread for AoE (Zealous Benediction)
40%-0%: don't stand in his hitbox when he transforms, use stability for fear, cycles through all phases
Tower team: capture towers to disable turrets
Road team: kill mobs, disarm mines and escort Glenna - focus wargs
Road Team: One person remain near Glenna or else she gets a debuff, use special action key to move her away from danger
Road Team: Look out for the warg coming from behind!
McLeod: hit matching coloured clone and kill warg
Green circles (Exposed Cored): two or more players in each
Push Construct Core into rifts (usually assign one player for this)
66% and 33% (Magic Blast): Absorb balls of the arrow color on your head
Bring tethered adds (Projections) one at a time to boss to kill, don't let them get close to eachother
Break defiance bar quickly when boss becomes stationary

cm_mechanics.text: Persistent pulsing ring - stay near the core's center

mechanics.text: You cannot glide in this encounter, don't fall off anything
Use fountains to reduce madness bar if needed
After first two portals, one player take NE portal to press button
One player leaps over gap to press button 2
Main squad: take new portal after killing mobs, then take the SW portal at fork
Main squad on U Shaped platform: Go to the right ledge of the left portal, dodge off edge to land on top of gate. Drop off the gate to find button 3, kill pack to reveal button 4
One player should actually take the left portal on the U shaped platform and stealth/movement skill to get button 5 (there's an extra button there too if any were missed)
Once all buttons are pressed, run left over a rocky area and up staircases to reach final door
Small platforms: stand on buttons (assign near/mid/far, rotate clockwise at 9 stacks) and push shards
Main platform: destroy shards clockwise while avoiding AoEs
Pink platform (Gravity Well): move to safe side of wall
Giant Xera: player with special action button (Ambient Magic) use it when phantasms reach back
Intermission: dodge rotating lasers and glide to side islands
Green circles (Spatial Manipulation): each shows how many players are required - send exactly that many players into each circle to prevent the attack
Red aura (Shared Agony): stay at edge of center compass away from group and other reds
Teleport: sidestep small red circles on the floor
Big arm attack (Orbital Sweep): stand opposite side and dodge
Gravity Wave: stack close to Cairn to mitigate

cm_mechanics.text: Use special action button every time it's up to avoid forced dashes
Must go in green circles to clear Unseen Burden stacks

mechanics.text: If designated, Claim orange tiles using special action button
Avoid green spikes (green-highlighted tiles) - after a few moments they spawn spikes that cannot be evaded or blocked and will instantly kill you
Avoid orange tiles - it hurts (but doesn't one shot)
Kill Jade Scouts and dispel their shields
Jade Soldiers fixate on the player with the Protect special action. That player should keep them away from the safe tile while the group kills them from range; they explode on death

cm_mechanics.text: Stand on your blue tile during detonation or die - quickly move away after if it's also green/orange

mechanics.text: Jump or dodge the shockwave - being knocked into the ring of spears around the arena results in instant death
Orange/green circles: drop them away from group together
Break bar during Brutalize to free fixated player
Samarog throws spears onto the arena floor that persist; they are rarely a priority - just cleave them down passively while focusing DPS and dodge his leap attacks
At 66% and 33% push the small add (Rigom) under Samarog while focusing damage on the larger add (Guldhem); only finish off Rigom once Guldhem is dead

cm_mechanics.text: Big orange circle can't move, green go on top of it - everyone else move

mechanics.text: Pre-fight: slow ghosts and break four chains
Hand Kiter pulls hands away from boss
Room wide aoe pizza (Annihilate): dodge through it
Mind Crush: stand in Saul's protective dome or use a block/Aegis to survive - outside the dome this attack deals lethal damage over time
Purple tears: walk through to close
75/50/25%: survive Saul clone fight and kill adds
60% and below: Don't stand in red circles oils (Rapid Decay)!!
10%: platform shrinks - dodge knockbacks and finish quickly

cm_mechanics.text: No Saul bubble for Mind Crush: on CM there is no protective dome, so players must rely on blocks or Aegis to survive; invulnerability effects like Distortion do not prevent the damage
Saul does NOT assist - higher ambient pressure; handle demonic tears and oil puddles cleanly to avoid chaos
Demonic aura damage ramps harder - healers plan sustain; DPS avoid greed during oils and Annihilate
Mismanaging demonic tears snowballs quickly - prioritize handling mechanics over DPS checks

mechanics.text: Two tanks pick up glowing runes to gain the Issue Challenge special action. Alternate using the action so one tank takes Necrosis stacks while the other lets theirs expire - Necrosis stacks fall off 30 s after the last application and Issue Challenge has a ~45 s cooldown. Face the boss away from the group, stand near the edge of the inner circle, and dodge spin attacks.
Avoid and dodge all yellow/orange/red damage indicators (cones, circles, dots, scythes)
Cleave down flesh wurms quickly when they spawn
Break the Howling Death defiance bar immediately after the boss's spin - failing to do so triggers an uncleanseable fear that forces everyone off the platform and wipes the squad
Arena crumbles at 90/66/33%, don't be on outer circle
Spirit walls: time movement through gaps, cannot be dodged through
Knock Tormented Dead off platform, AoE cleave damage on them

cm_mechanics.text: Necrosis builds faster, swap tanks as soon as special action key available
Flesh Wurms respawn
Arena shrinks early; final space is tight

mechanics.text: Stand inside Desmina's protective bubble to avoid Soul Siphon damage
Split into a "forward" group to clear trash ahead, and "escort" group to speed up and heal Desmina
Kill Enervators quickly - if they reach Desmina the bubble weakens
Break the Bomber's defiance bar or block their explosion to protect the bubble
Destroy Spatial Rifts with repeated hits before they drag the party inside
Players targeted by expanding circle AoEs should drop them behind the bubble or on Skeletons that are chasing Desmina
Avoid Surging Soul walls by moving through the gaps
If downed, collect five orbs in the spirit realm to revive yourself
Only use auto-attacks - every 2% HP spawns green orbs (Frozen Wind)
The squad should aim for a total group DPS of ~75k to beat the enrage time but not overburden themselves with orbs
Pick up orbs, but do not go over 3 stacks or it freezes you. Each stack falls off after 45 seconds
Avoid icy fissures and orange triangle AoEs on the floor
Goal is to light six torches above the Jackal portal by collecting floating red orbs above Eater's arena, the boss regenerates anytime it is killed
Avoid standing in the boss' Puke attack, it is extremely deadly
Kill spider-shaped Twisted Spirit at edge to spawn white orbs of Reclaimed energy on platforms
When the Twisted Spirit spawns, Tank should move the boss onto the glowing tile, as killing the boss over it releases 10 red orbs
Pick up white orbs and use special action to throw them onto the glowing tile (ideally under the boss); deposit five to phase the boss
Stand in green circle to become a wisp, collect 5 red orbs while in the air to light a torch
Break the boss's defiance bar when it leaps to the middle tile, or send a wisp player to be sucked in as a sacrifice
Failing to collect 5 orbs in 30 seconds as a wisp instantly kills you, if you can't make it use Spirit Surge to go outside the arena putting you in downed state instead
Assign two players to throw Light Orbs to the players below, one thrower per group, use Weapon Skill 1 to throw
Split the other players into two groups - North and South; assign a stunner in the group to pick up light orbs and use Weapon Skill 2 to stun the Eye
Ensure to not use hard CC once the Light Orb has stunned the eye, since it will override the stun
Kill both Eyes within 15 seconds of each other or they revive
Cleave down Light Thieves that spawn
Hide behind statues when the Eye beam targets you; avoid or destroy the minotaur if the stun fails
Pre-event: protect Reapers by killing Enforcers and Deathlings while kiting Messengers away
Greens (ritual circles): every 30 s Dhuum reaches for a Reaper. The assigned player stands in the green circle, is lifted into the air and must collect five red orbs while airborne to save the Reaper

Affliction: starting around 9:00, a player receives a bomb debuff. The afflicted player should leave the group until the bomb detonates (≈13 s) to avoid downing others; bombs cannot be detonated early and spawn one at a time
Lesser Death Mark: Dhuum lands on a random player with a large orange circle. Anyone caught loses their boons and becomes separated from their soul - quickly step back over your soul to avoid dying

Greater Death Mark (~6:30 and 3:30): Dhuum teleports to the center and knocks everyone out of their bodies. Stand near the edge and face outward so the knockback sends you to the wall, then quickly reclaim your soul to avoid instant death
Shackles tether two players - run apart to break the chain quickly
Avoid the Scythe Rake cone by standing to the boss's side or behind him
At 10% (seal phase), everyone becomes spirits - collect orbs then gather in the center protection bubble, leaving to activate seals outside the bubble when available

cm_mechanics.text: Dhuum has more health and Reaper heals are weaker; maximize DPS and sustain
Ender's Echo periodically charges around the arena; reposition to avoid it and break its bar quickly to free grabbed players
Failure to manage shackles or Death Mark results in severe party damage; react immediately
Additional bombs and fissures may spawn; coordinate positions to drop bombs safely while maintaining DPS

mechanics.text: Assign players to collect Sword and Shield orbs from each arm during smash phases and return to the platform
Sword carriers use the special action to strip the boss's Conjured Protection stacks and expose him to damage
Shield carriers use the special action to block Slam, Junk Wall and Thunderhead Clap attacks for the group
Avoid purple damage orbs scattered on the platform during collection phases
After destroying one arm, repeat the pattern on the opposite side at 50%

cm_mechanics.text: Arms stay active ~8s only - collect orbs and burst limbs FAST before they despawn
Light Beam fixates a player - line-of-sight or block with an arm or Shield carrier; it's lethal if you face-tank it
Extra conjured weapons spawn - assign more collectors; Sword strips stacks, Shield blocks Junk Wall/Clap windows

mechanics.text: Split the squad: fight Nikare on the left and Kenut on the right while keeping their health even
Nikare's Aquatic Detainment: small orange circles appear under players - move out to avoid being floated
Large Geyser circles knock back and apply Waterlogged - avoid or block them
When targeted by Tidal Pool, drop the growing water pool at the platform edge, away from others
Vapor Rush dashes toward the furthest player - sidestep the dashes; Kenut's Vapor Jet teleports to the furthest player and creates a rectangular attack - kite or dodge it
Sea Swell sends a shockwave across the platform; jump or dodge to avoid being launched
Cyclone Burst spawns circles on Kenut's platform that grant boons to the boss - sidestep to minimize boons
Avoid roaming water tornadoes on Kenut's platform
At 50% and 25% health, jump to the next set of platforms; follow callouts to avoid falling
During Aquatic Barrage (split platforms), break each boss's defiance bar quickly to stop their spin and projectile attack
Kill together: if one Largos dies far ahead of the other, the survivor ENRAGES and melts the squad - keep HP even

cm_mechanics.text: At 20% intervals, a lethal wave crosses the platform - jump onto water spouts to dodge the wipe attack
Water tornadoes and Sea Swells become more frequent; manage positioning carefully to avoid knockbacks
Waterlogged stacks accumulate faster; cleanse or avoid Geysers and Tornado hits to maintain damage output

mechanics.text: Assign a kiter on Qadim's platform to kill Lava Elementals and keep Qadim from channeling
Lamp team enters the lamp at the start and at 66% and 33% to rescue allies; kill enemies inside and free the allies
Hydra phase (100-66%): break the Hydra's defiance bar before the meteor; tank avoids cone bites and Flame Breath. Don't stand under its hitbox, one of its attacks teleports you away
Pyres phase: split to kill Pyres quickly; un-killed Pyres spawn fireballs that down players
Qadim's Flame Wave and Flame Dance can knock you off - sidestep or avoid the glowing patterns
When targeted by a meteor arrow during Qadim's break bar, run to a Pyre platform or break the bar to avoid group damage
Destroyer phase (66-33%): break the Apocalypse Bringer's bar and kill its Reapers while avoiding shockwaves
Wyvern phase: assign tanks to Patriarch and Matriarch; dodge Flame Breath and Tail Swipe and kill adds quickly
Final phase (33-0%): Jumping puzzle - platforms disappear, group up on Zommoros' protected platform. Chase down Qadim, kill elementals that spawn at 15%

cm_mechanics.text: No updrafts to save you if you fall; lamp mobs have more HP and new attacks - plan movement carefully
Destroyed platforms restrict movement - coordinate where to stand and move early
A breakbar appears after every shockwave; heavy CC is required or the squad takes massive damage
Pyres burn players and fireballs spawn more frequently - kill Pyres quickly to limit damage
Fiery meteors fall more often; break Qadim's bar or intercept meteors to prevent group wipes
Dodge or block the new bouncy fire orb that jumps around during non-Qadim phases

mechanics.text: At the start, drop rock pillars at preset positions; they will provide cover for later mechanics. Dropping them too close to another player's pillar destroys it
During Blinding Light (eye above bosses head), turn character away to avoid being blinded
When the following shockwave hits, hide behind a pillar to avoid being knocked away
Two players per pillar catch boulder barrages by standing behind the pillar; catch both hits to destroy the pillar
At 75/50/25% a sand wall rotates around the arena - run with the wall and jump over missing tiles to avoid being swept out
After each sand wall, Hands of Eruption/Erosion appear - kill them quickly and block or dodge their projectiles
Watch for disappearing floor tiles and avoid falling through them

cm_mechanics.text: Falling into the sand is instant death - mind your footing and jump correctly
Three sand walls instead of one; destroyed pillars remove tiles, reducing safe ground
Plan pillar placements carefully; lost pillars reduce cover and expose the group to Blinding Light

mechanics.text: Stand under static charges to gain Violent Current stacks; at five stacks you get a teleport to break bars or avoid shockwaves
At 90% health, Sabir casts Electric Repulsion - break his large bar quickly to stop it
At 80% and 60%, move to the side platforms by killing Voltaic Wisps and using updrafts; return via updrafts after clearing
During Unbridled Tempest (shockwave), use your teleport, tornado or invulnerability to survive; normal dodge will not work
At 60% the Ion Shield appears - coordinate teleports and heavy CC to break the bar quickly or Sabir gains massive damage reduction
After 50%, a death tornado circles the platform - rotate with the tornado while handling Fury of the Storm and safe zones
Paralyzing Wisps spawn on side platforms at 40/30/20/10%; kill them or use projectile reflects to avoid immobilization

cm_mechanics.text: Downed players gain a debuff making them harder to revive; break bars require more CC to succeed
Additional orange lines appear during Electric Repulsion - spread out and watch your positioning
Paralyzing Wisps now spawn on the main platform; coordinate to kill them quickly or use projectile reflects

mechanics.text: Before the fight, break each pylon's bar and assign kiters to tether them using flux disruptors while the tank tethers to Qadim
Chaos Currents (moving electric lines) travel around the arena - avoid touching them
After a pylon is broken, Qadim releases a knockback wave (Force of Retaliation); dodge or use stability to survive
When Qadim leaps to a pylon, anomalies spawn - pick up red orbs and carry them to your controlled pylon to destroy anomalies
Force of Havoc is a long rectangular attack aimed at the tank; aim it away from group and pylons
Force of Ruin fires triple missiles at random players after 60% - dodge or block them
Fire phases at 80/60%: stack flames between pylons, break pylon anomaly bars and dodge the end-of-phase shockwave
Final 20%: there are no pylons - survive overlapping mechanics and continue carrying orbs to stop meteors

cm_mechanics.text: Avoid Titanic Twisters swirling at the arena edge - they are instant death
Rain of Chaos leaves persistent lava AoEs - reposition quickly and avoid standing in fire
At 40/30/20% pylon phases, everyone must stand in the south white circle and share stability to survive the wipe mechanic
After each pylon phase, golden orbs appear - collect them and use your special action to stop meteor attacks

mechanics.text: The furthest player kites lightning arrows; hide behind a lightning rod to line-of-sight the red arrow or die instantly
When green orbs spawn near rods, stand in them - one/two/three players depending on orb size - to dissipate charge
A series of smashes sweeps across the arena: cross the first two half-arena hits and dodge the final cascading smash at the last moment
Stomp creates shockwaves on outer and inner rings; stay in melee range and share stability to avoid being knocked back
Orange circles appear on melee players - spread out and break the defiance bar at 75% while soaking green orbs to reset rods
After the break bar, soak green orbs again to recharge rods; prepare for the next phase
Phase 2: ranged (furthest) group kites arrows away from rods while avoiding Violent Winds; they cannot soak orbs during this phase
Phase 3: multiple arrow types occur - three melee players block the green arrow at a rod while others handle red/orange arrows and reposition

cm_mechanics.text: Decima becomes Godsquall Decima; she has more health and gains Peal of Discord stacks
Conduits change positions and green orbs persist while rods are charged; coordinate soaking and rod rotation
New attacks: Discordant Thunder, Seismic Reposition, Seismoelectric Leap and Sparking Reverberation with a break bar - dodge or break bars quickly
Orange/spread arrows apply Exposed; players with charged leap must coordinate their dodge timing to avoid overlap
Transcendent Boulders link two players - destroy both boulders simultaneously or the linked players die

mechanics.text: Alternate between Greer and split phases; at 80/50/20% break Greer's bar to remove Empowered stacks and make him vulnerable
Stay behind Greer to avoid his frontal cleave; watch for triple shockwave pulses and dodge the final wave
The furthest player attracts homing orbs; reflect, block, roll through, or mesmer distortion (with max stacks) these projectiles to prevent Greer gaining Empowered stacks
Spread out to soak green circles (Eruption of Rot); each player should choose one circle to be in, do not overlap
Stomp leaps leave vine walls; avoid standing between walls and reposition after each leap
Seeds of Decay spawns Empowering Beasts - kill them quickly and dodge the orange barrage
At 66% and 33%, split into two groups to damage Greer and his clone Reeg to 50% simultaneously

cm_mechanics.text: Greer becomes Godspoil Greer; Ereg the Enabler spawns as a third Greerling - kill or manage Ereg quickly
Champion proto-greerlings spawn at 10% health - burst them down before they boost the boss
Plague Rot effects (Cage of Decay, Enfeebling Miasma, Ripples of Rot) corrupt boons and apply poison; 10 stacks is fatal - cleanse and reposition

mechanics.text: Ura gains Rising Pressure stacks every 5% health - break her bar at each 5% to reduce stacks and lower damage
Collect Bloodstone Shards to free float-trapped players and to destroy Sulfuric Geysers; rotate shard carriers because of the debuff
Toxic Geysers create damaging fields - break their bars quickly to remove them
Sulfuric Geysers cannot be CC'd - drop a Bloodstone Shard on them or they leave Exposed puddles
Titanspawn Geysers spawn champion Titans; break the bar then kill the Titan quickly before it enrages
Rock Ring traps a player inside eggs - run out of the group, then back once you're given stability
Ura leaps at the furthest player; avoid being targeted and sidestep the shockwave
Around 70% health a Whirlpool pulls everyone to center - use a Bloodstone Shard to break it or the group dies
Keep Ura away from geyser fields; she gains boons and damage if she stands in them

cm_mechanics.text: Geysers become untargetable and permanent; Titanspawn Geysers are not removed on break - manage the growing number of hazards
Champion Fumarollers cap the arena and defiance bars are much stronger - allocate more CC
At 1% health Ura heals 15% and the timer extends; Titanic Resistance increases her bar after each break, making subsequent breaks harder

mechanics.text: Red (Vermilion): watch the In/Out ring arrows; stand inside or outside and drop Boiling Aether puddles along the wall
Green (Arsenite): a kiter holds aggro at range; tethered players drop puddles on the edges and move far to break the tether
Blue (Indigo): stack close to mitigate push; walk into the boss during Wind Gust and spread out for orange circles and teleport tethers
Boiling Aether puddles persist until removed - always drop them at the arena edges and avoid standing in them
Break defiance bars at 80% (Green), 40% (Red) and 10% (Blue) to create safe zones; failing results in a lethal AoE
Tanks must keep Red and Green bosses apart; mixing their attacks causes heavy damage

cm_mechanics.text: 13-minute timer; breakbar puzzles at 100/60/20% - break the bar to invert lethal AoEs and create a safe zone
Boiling Aether puddles persist until the next CC; drop them along walls and use defensive skills to place tethers inside existing puddles
Fixates last until downed - tanks must keep Red and Green separated at all times
Failing a breakbar puzzle gives players Exposed and empowers bosses; additional tethers and larger AoEs require quick response
Breakbar puzzle at 100/60/20%: FAILING a bar triggers a wipe-tier AoE - you must CC to create the safe zone

mechanics.text: Stack in melee to avoid spinning boulders; stay together for heals
Jump or dodge the shockwave slam attack
Avoid red circles (falling icicles) and swirling ice orbs
Dodge or sidestep the half-arena arm sweep to prevent knockback
At 50% boss goes invulnerable and knocks back everyone - use stability or dodge
Large red arrow on you: face it away from the group
If encased in ice (icicle), mash your Special Action (skill 1) to break out
Jump or dodge the ground shockwaves during the giant phase
Move to the opposite side when the giant sweeps half the room with ice
Kill small elementals quickly (or spread out) to avoid fatal stacked blasts
Kill both bosses around the same time to avoid enrage (cleave evenly if possible)
Move out of all red or yellow ground AoEs
Cleanse immobilizing red arrow attacks or use reflects
Break their shared defiance bar promptly when it appears
Spread out for orange circles; stack tightly inside green circle AoEs
At 75% and 25% health, you'll be isolated-kill your own clone quickly
Chains: if tethered to boss, stand still close to boss; others avoid crossing chains
Final 25%: avoid or purposefully detonate the many frozen orbs (Necro Flesh Wurm can soak center)
Ambient darkness ramps damage as torches go out - expect increasing pressure even if you ignore re-lighting
Torches: squads often heal through darkness instead of re-lighting, but breaking bars & dodging leaps are mandatory
Stack on commander (melee); all dodge in the same direction (left) when boss raises its right arm
Break the defiance bar to prevent a scream that knocks back and extinguishes torches
Dodge the leap attack and cleave down any adds that spawn
Stay with squad and push forward; prioritize killing snipers and mechs first
Avoid heavy bombardments - use cover, projectile defense, or dodge out of circles
Quickly break champion defiance bars and burst down final boss before timer runs out
Dodge Mai Trin's various attacks, break her defiance bar immediately to gain a damage boost
50% split: small adds spawn, kill them

33% split: two elite adds spawn - dump all hard CC the southwest one first since it has a huge breakbar, then kill northeast, then back to southwest for more CC.

Stand in green circle when it spawns
Mai Trin at 10%: Scarlet Briar spawns, dodger her orbs, jump/doge shockwave. Same elite add splits happen at 80% and 40%
If you get a blue line over your head / blue border on your screen - run out or it wipes the group

60% and 20% Deathray: 3 rotating "safe" areas spawn and Scarlet appears at the edge - stand where she wouldn't hit you in a straight line attack to await the correct safe spot - the other two get nuked
Photon Saturation: misplayed spreads/aoes give a stacking max-HP reduction - spread properly to avoid unnecessary damage

cm_mechanics.text: Mai Trin's cleave and Scarlet Briar's slam now add a stacking debuff, prioritize dodging
Green circle requires EXACTLY 3 players, no more no less - doing this mechanic gives you a debuff so you instant die if you do it again
Blue line mechanic now targets two players, run out of the group and drop them together to avoid too many lingering AoEs, make sure not to drop them where the two big adds spawn

Deathray mechanic now has two players get giant cross AoE markers over them, they need to use the special action key to attach their markers to nearby "ferrous objects" in such a way that the crosses don't hit the team's safe zone

mechanics.text: Spread out when orange circles appear; overlapping them deals lethal damage
Avoid green poison pools and cleanse conditions quickly
Dodge the swirling vacuum pull (Imminent Death) or use movement skills to escape
Break Ankka's defiance bar whenever it appears to interrupt lethal casts and enable a DPS phase
Handle hallucinations: dodge or block the Quaggan explosions, run away from the Krait pull AoEs and have the tethered player kite the Lich hallucination away from the group
Final phase: stand in purple sanctuaries to survive Devouring Void stacks and focus down the Reanimated Eye add

cm_mechanics.text: 10-minute timer; Inevitability of Death acts as an enrage that resets on phase changes
Persistent Zhaitan's Reaches and extra Reanimated adds spawn - kill or CC them quickly
Imminent Death pull circles instantly kill anyone stacked together; spread out and leave immediately
Imminent Death pull: stacking is lethal - spread before the pull circle spawns and leave IMMEDIATELY
Orange circles become more lethal and must be baited and spread perfectly
In the final phase, stand in protective sanctuaries to survive Devouring Void and kill the Reanimated Antipathy quickly

mechanics.text: When the sniper appears, three players stand in the green circle on the roof to soak the shot
Dragon Slash - Force: dodge or stand behind Minister Li; Boost: watch the arrow and sidestep; Reach: numbered players spread and run away before the beam
During the Mindblade/Enforcer phase, kite the Mindblade and Enforcer apart; break their bars and kill them before they merge
The Ritualist stays mid-platform and drops large orange AoEs - move to the edges or dodge to avoid them
Multiple players may get orange circles at once - spread out and don't overlap, especially during Force
Final phase: soak sniper's green circles, split targets for Mech Rider and Sniper attacks, and keep their health within 20% to avoid Jade Rain

cm_mechanics.text: No guard rails - falling off the rooftop is instant death
Shared Destruction green circles now require three players; failure downs the squad
Dragon Slash: Force is unblockable and must be dodged; Reach leaves deadly red lines - marked players must return quickly
Enhanced damage from Heaven's Palm and Enforcer flames - spread out to bait AoEs and avoid crossing attacks
New debuffs (Debilitated, Infirmity, Exposed) reduce DPS and healing - play cautiously and cleanse when possible
Mech Rider and Sniper must die together; keep them within 20% HP and separate them to avoid lethal Jade Rain

mechanics.text: Escort the white orb through each lane and kill or CC any enemies that touch it
Jump or dodge shockwaves (Mordremoth & Soo-Won phases only); always stack in green safe circles; spread out orange circle markers
Handle each Elder Dragon's unique attacks as they come (projectiles, beams, CCs); stay on the commander's tag
Cleave down giant summons quickly; use stability or stun breaks for fear and stomp attacks; avoid standing in their vomit AoE
When Primordus appears, dodge his massive chomp attack (instant down if hit)
Final phase: continue handling greens and other avoids; focus down remaining adds ASAP

cm_mechanics.text: General - Boss has low armor, so power DPS is king; condition DPS underperforms (use Sigils of Night/Bloodlust for max damage)
General - Spreads: 7 closest players get orange circles; never overlap them (assign baiters beforehand)
General - Red Puddles: 2 closest players to center drop lethal red puddles after ~5-6s; those players kite them to the edges
General - Falling off or being knocked off the platform results in instant death; be very careful near edges
General - Several stealth phases occur; use Mass Invisibility and do NOT break stealth early
General - Portal usage: only take portals after Purification phases and after Champions as a DPS (to return to boss quickly)
General - Each dragon's attack pattern loops if they live long enough; depending on DPS you may see 2-3 repeats of a dragon's rotation
Purification 1 - Kill Voidcrawlers to gain push stacks; prioritize those blocking the orb's path
Purification 1 - As a group, push the orb through three white circles; break the bar at the third circle, then take portal to boss
Dragon 1 (Jormag) - At start, bait red puddles to edges; stand near edges to easily dodge the linear ice lasers
Dragon 1 (Jormag) - After each green circle, seven players get spreads; step inward from the edge before they drop to bait safely
Dragon 2 (Primordus) - Stay stealthed (do not reveal) during approach; clear all adds immediately upon spawn
Dragon 2 (Primordus) - Pattern: spreads → red puddles → massive chomp; use portal to reach back of hitbox safely; Primordus will do three chin slams in a row
Dragon 3 (Kralkatorrik) - Stay stealthed (don't reveal); kill the Void adds, then stack tightly in the boss's midsection
Dragon 3 (Kralkatorrik) - After side beam attack, rotate clockwise (right); bait red puddles and avoid the central beam when boss turns
Purification 2 + Timecaster - Run to NW island; hard-CC and burst the Timecaster miniboss (reflect its shredding projectiles)
Purification 2 + Timecaster - Push the orb through two circles; kill the Timecaster before the orb arrives at second circle
Purification 2 + Timecaster - Kill, blind, or CC the Skullpiercer adds quickly; respect their knockbacks (stay in center of platform)
Dragon 4 (Mordremoth) - Bait red puddles as usual; the right side of Mordremoth's hitbox is safe from initial spit attacks-stack tightly there
Dragon 4 (Mordremoth) - Pattern: spreads → three shockwave jumps; missing any jump causes a squad wipe (only use stability if absolutely necessary for one jump)
Dragon 5 (Zhaitan) - Stay stealthed (don't reveal early); when Giants spawn, immediately hard-CC and burst them down on the group
Dragon 5 (Zhaitan) - Immediately stack in the close green circle (at least 5 inside); Zhaitan becomes targetable as the green ends
Dragon 5 (Zhaitan) - Bait red puddles, then the boss will Scream (fear + damage) - cleanse, heal, and stun break; right after, spread out for orange circles
Purification 3 + Saltspray - Stay stealthed (don't reveal); DPS race on Saltspray Dragon miniboss and break its bar ASAP
Purification 3 + Saltspray - Push the orb through circle 1 to circle 2, break the bar, then run back through portal to boss platform
Dragon 6 (Soo-Won) - Bait red puddles; greens begin immediately as Soo-Won lands-ALL DPS must get in close green (goal: 4+ people inside)
Dragon 6 (Soo-Won) - A shockwave hits during that first green: dodge or jump while inside; then spreads occur followed by a massive tail swipe-run to edge of platform
Dragon 6 (Soo-Won) - Tail Swipe is an instant kill and larger than the visual; if you aren't at the edge, stand between arrow markers to survive
Dragon 6 (Soo-Won) - Clear remaining adds, strip boons, and burst DPS; after this rotation, mechanics loop from reds → greens again if boss is still alive
Champions - Stay stealthed (don't reveal early); kill order: CC and burst Goliath first (it inflicts heavy chill, knockbacks, and fire fields)
Champions - When Goliath's break bar ends, a portal appears under it-take this portal to avoid its massive AoE explosion
Champions - After killing all champions, resume Soo-Won's rotation until the fight ends (if any champion lived and walks to boss, finish it off)

mechanics.text: Shooting Star: the player with a green arrow is targeted - at least five players must stack in front of them to share damage and avoid healing reduction
Spinning Nebula: Dagda spins and fires projectiles; move away, dodge and body-block if needed to avoid the damaging field
Seven players get orange circles - spread out to avoid overlapping meteor strikes
At 90/75/50/25% Demonic Blast occurs: dodge the red cone pattern, kill the Tormented adds and avoid Residual Anxiety stacks
Soul Feast fixates a player - they kite the entity away while others collect lights and use special action to destroy it
During split phases (75/50/25%): dodge the push wave, kill adds and throw the light orb at the pink ghost copy to continue
Break Dagda's large defiance bar to greatly reduce incoming mega-blast damage and secure a DPS window

cm_mechanics.text: 10-minute enrage timer; Dagda has more health and damage
Spinning Nebula projectiles apply a heavy damage-reduction debuff - avoid or cleanse quickly
Dagda gains Demonic Resistance periodically; remove it by using the light special action on him
Orange circles and Soul Feasts occur more frequently; be ready to spread out and manage multiple adds
Failing to break the Demonic Blast defiance bar wipes the group - heavy CC is required
Numbered players and two green circles spawn - spread according to your numeral and have at least three players in each green circle or the boss gains Planetary Weight stacks
Additional champion and veteran adds appear during split phases; focus them down before resuming the fight

mechanics.text: Break Cerus's defiance bar at 80/50/10% to prevent a massive heal
During split phases, kill the two correct Embodiments (usually the Eye and Shout) to avoid empowering Cerus
Crushing Regret: stand at least five players in the green circle to soak; if Empowered, three smaller circles spawn but can be stacked
Cry of Rage: large AoE around Cerus - move away to avoid damage and Exposed; Empowered version is larger and unavoidable
Envious Gaze: rotating demonic wall that corrupts boons - stay close and rotate with the wall; Empowered version spawns a second faster wall
Malicious Intent: tethered player spawns a shadow; run away to stretch tether, slow or kill the shadow before it reaches Cerus; Empowered version creates three tethers
Insatiable Hunger: orbs move toward Cerus - body-block them to prevent barrier gain (your debuff stacks); Empowered version spawns more orbs and debuff doesn't expire
Wail of Despair: orange circles on all players - spread out and dodge; puddles persist and pulse torment; Empowered version has larger, longer-lasting pools
Manage Empowered stacks - failing mechanics or killing the wrong Embodiment grants Cerus Empowered stacks, increasing his damage

cm_mechanics.text: 10-minute timer and no arena walls - falling off kills you instantly
Cerus and Aspect adds have much more health; Aspects spawn one at a time and cast invulnerability if not killed quickly
Only one specific Aspect can be killed per split phase; killing the wrong one empowers Cerus with new attacks
Green circles require at least three players; failing multiple soaks instantly downs the squad
Cry of Rage and rolling orbs become unavoidable damage - multiple players must body-block orbs to reduce Empowered stacks
Empowered mechanics rotate more frequently; coordinate aspect kills and be ready to adapt each phase

mechanics.text: A player must pick up the Artifact to start; this person becomes tank in Phase 1 and kiter in Phase 2. Keep the Artifact away from Kela and throw it to another player if needed - if Kela gets it, the squad wipes
Toss: Kela occasionally throws players standing in front of her. Face the boss away from the group so only the tank is thrown

Bees: A dark-orange circle appears on a player, dealing increasing damage - this spreads if touching other players. Spread out in Phase 1 to not immediately share it. After the person with bees gets around 15 stacks a healer can run on them to reset stacks and share the damage.
Waves: Arrows and an orange rectangle telegraph a crashing wave that inflicts heavy burning damage and knockback. Move out or stack and heal through if no other option
Executors of Waves (crabs) spawn around the arena, creating growing quicksand that slows players and grants Kela protection. Kill them when convenient between phases to stop the sand from spreading
Crocodiles fixate players and leap, causing heavy damage and long stuns. Kill them quickly in Phase 1. In Phase 2, down them and leave them alive as bait for Kela - don't finish them off
Tornadoes and Storm Lightning complicate positioning: tornadoes knock players around, while in Phase 2 orange circles mark lightning strikes that stun and damage - dodge out of these areas

Artifact kiting: During the Storm (Phase 2) the kiter runs along the arena edge while the group downs crocodiles. Lead Kela over downed crocs to reset her speed. If Kela catches the kiter or another player gets too close, it's an instant kill and wipe
Break bar: When the storm ends, Kela channels a squad-wide damaging beam. Heal through it and break her defiance bar quickly to return to Phase 1

cm_mechanics.text: Bees become lethal if they hit a downed player; assign clean spreads/shares and prioritize immediate revives on bee targets
Waves are instant-kill on hit; keep Kela in center lane when possible and only step into side lanes briefly to avoid waves
Crocodiles fixated players kite on arena edge opposite wave spawns, non-targeted allies don't stand in between the crocs and kiter
Crab quicksand is higher priority, it's much harder to escape and can trap players in center; use leaps/superspeed/ranged to kill crabs quickly
During breakbar channel, Kela still heavily damages squad; to make DPS check teams may need to stack-heal and DPS through while breaking

mechanics.text: Ascension: you start with 10 stacks; losing all of them kills you. Failed mechanics also empower Vloxx, increasing his damage and defenses.
Large greens (Judgment of Eternity): separate the three circles; put 3 players TOTAL in each. Don't overlap greens.
Small greens with chains (Ascension's Sacrifice): keep the circles separate; each floating player needs 1 helper underneath them (2 players total). Stun-break to move again.
Purple diamond (Fixate): stand opposite the squad across Vloxx to aim his attacks away; the target can change during the fight.
Orange circles following players: drop the lingering puddles away from the squad, then move out once placed.
Staff: sidestep the orange arrow and giant orb; jump/dodge the shockwave where Vloxx teleports. Avoid staff projectiles - blocking/reflecting makes them bounce and explode.
Spear: leave red arrows, orange cones and falling-spear circles; avoid the damaging trail after his charge.
Sword: avoid rotating half-circle slashes and travelling swords; dodge the pull and stay out of the teleport left behind.
70% / 40% / 10% splits: kill the required adds shown in the event tracker, then CC Vloxx's breakbar. Collect dropped orbs to restore Ascension and remove Empowered stacks.

cm_mechanics.text: 10-minute hard enrage; after the 10% split, kill Vloxx within 2 minutes 5 seconds or the squad wipes.
Champion weapon Aspects persist during boss phases: Staff from the start, Spear below 70%, Sword below 40%. Kill them to stop extra attacks and rising Empowered stacks; they respawn.

Weapon Aspects gain a breakbar at 25% health. Break it and collect the Ascension orbs to restore stacks and reduce Empowered. A reported bug prevents orbs spawning if Vloxx has no Empowered stacks when the bar breaks.
Worldpiercer: 6 red arrows instantly kill anyone hit. Move between sectors through Vloxx's hitbox; crossing the lingering blue barriers needs stability, or dodge with a cleanse ready.

mechanics.text: Mine tunnel: swim the channel and steer clear of floating mines
Laser hall: cross the lit floor by stepping only on dark tiles and cleansing conditions
Security grid: coordinate terminals to drop forcefields while dodging patrols
Deck fight: clear pirates and sidestep cannon lines and bombardments
Boss - Aetherblade captain with golems: kite golems to corners, avoid rotating lasers, use boxes for line-of-sight if needed
Start: free the two fishermen to open the paths
Next route is random: dolphin stealth route or deep route with piranha wards
Deep route: light plants to repel piranha, kill krait and jellyfish groups
Dolphin route: only one player needs to reach the end while avoiding krait
Boss - Jellyfish: dodge the spin, press the special skill to escape swallow, kill add spawns at 75/50/25%
Bombs: purple bomb stands on Mai Trin to strip shield; red bomb move away to avoid the cannon
Keep close to prevent teleports and break defiance bar on cast
Cannon phase: dodge line shots and break line of sight behind cover
Entrance: Kill the initial pack then run to the right - then down a path on your left. Follow jumping puzzles to the first boss
Chaos Anomaly: kill golems and drop flux bombs away from allies
Blizzard: light bonfires with special action while avoiding tentacles
Boss - Anomaly: lure onto electric tiles to break shield, dodge pulls and spin slams
Hammer duty: carry the hammer and watch corruption stacks
Charge the hammer by killing cultists and break knee, chest and arm seals in order
Swap the carrier when corruption stacks get high
Disable wind and explosive traps using chains and switches
Boss - Archdiviner: use hammer to break the neck seal, avoid wells and cages, break defiance bar
Split start: Jump down to the main area then 2+ players head west 2+ players head east
West group: Dodge through the tiles to reach the end, stand on the runestones to open the door, kill the Deepstone Sentinel to pick up its Orb of Light
East group: Cross the bridge dodging the wind knock off, stand on runestones to open the door, kill the Brood Queen to get her Orb of Light
Put the Orbs of Light in the Vibrant Crystal you get teleported to to get the Light of Deldrimor special action button
Make your way through the rest of the fractal using the Light of Deldrimor to make hidden enemies and floor tiles visible
Boss - Arch-Diviner's Shade: restore floor tiles with special action and break defiance bar, kill adds during immunity phase before they reach him
Run through the facility quickly ignoring most adds, kill adds at the drawn bridges to open them
Mid-boss - Molten Effigy: burst it down to proceed
Final duo - Firestorm and Berserker: focus Firestorm (flying guy) first, then finish Berserker
Dodge Berserker shockwaves and avoid Firestorm's Firestorm fields
Press through the foundry, destroying vents and dodging cave-ins
Weapons lab: keep sentinel suits apart and use bombs to strip shields
Thermal core: destroy it while dodging fireballs, shockwaves and tornadoes
Final encounter: defeat suits and engineer (keep them apart)
Shore: use the cannon to blow up the mine to open the wall, go inside and have someone man the cannon while the rest go into the pit to fight Blasting Black Peter
Maze: pass cursed treasure between players to avoid immobilize and patrolling add spawns, bring all 3 bags to the end then take the treasure to the ship
On the ship: send 2+ people to grab the treasure on shore while others use cannons to defend them - defeat Mad Jack Squall and First Mate Calix while dodging winds and cone attacks
Boss - Captain Crowe: share green circles, dodge ghost winds, drop puddles on the edge
Escort: huddle near bonfires and feed wood to melt the ice wall
Shaman camp: light the five bonfires and use projectile hate to keep them lit
Boss - Svanir Shaman: dodge Icy Breath and Spikes, break bar at 75/50/25%
Each phase: destroy crystals and the effigy add; at 25% the boss turns into a wolf
Clear Fire / Ice / Earth / Air platforms, then take the portal onward. Fire: dodge rotating walls. Earth: dodge the expanding ring.
Ice Sprite (purple orb over a player): CC its breakbar immediately. Air (red circles): spread from friends, then dodge as your circle fills; the hit strips boons and dazes.
Eternal Tyrant: watch for the targeted homing white orb; dodge or block it to avoid being launched. Attack targets can change during the fight.
Orange circle following you (black hole): move to the arena edge, away from friends; leave the pool after it drops.

70% / 40%: kill incoming elementals before they reach the boss. Their launch pools activate after 3 seconds - use one to get airborne before the arena-wide lethal cast finishes. At 40%, also dodge/block the missile barrage.
Below 40%: earlier platform mechanics return together - dodge firewalls/earth rings, spread lightning circles, and CC the Ice Sprite.
1%: boss becomes invulnerable and casts the lethal blast again, faster. Immediately use the nearby launch pad; stay airborne until it resolves.

cm_mechanics.text: CM unlock: complete Solitary Throne at tier 4, then activate the challenge mote and accept the harbinger's challenge.
Construct of Galdra: a persistent, invulnerable enemy uses disruptive attacks during the boss fight. Dodge its attacks and break its defiance bar to temporarily disable it.
CM details are incomplete: additional differences have not yet been verified. Use the normal mechanics as a starting point and check current sources before attempting CM.

mechanics.text: Platforming: Run to the end of the level ignoring enemies
Tentacle fields: kill tentacles to spawn reflecting crystals
Crystal duty: pick up a crystal, survive the laser (red skull) and throw it at the boss
Final beam: everyone should hold a crystal to reflect the sweep
Wisp run: carry three wisps to clefts together, avoid traps, call “r” when ready since the timer is shared
Mini-boss - Mossman: watch for stealth backstab and kite safely
Boss - Bloomhunger: stand in rotating greens, dodge charge and leap, avoid poison rain
Add control: kill spirits before they reach Bloomhunger
When boss is at 25% spread to the sides of the room to grab wisps and deliver them
Hub: complete four wings - Subject 6, Dormitories, Maze and Heat - the first 3 will drop Cooling Rods to help with the last
Subject 6: burst DPS, kill healing oozes and stop hitting when shielded
Dormitories: rescue scientists and destroy portals quickly
Maze: carry shields and coordinate switches to open the path - two on earlier switches and a third on the final (press in the middle)
Heat: Use the cooling rods on the walls in this room to give you save zones, hold Weapon Skill 1 for a boost, press the button at the end
Anomaly: Return to the central platform and activate the console, during the boss fight use your Hex Shield special action key to stabilize platforms and avoid falling
City approach: run directly to the Elite Sunspear Sandbinder
Zombie rooftop event: wipe at 75% is intended, then use special action to jump rooftops and kill marked adds
Boss - Amala: break bar during Mystic Detonation at every 20%
Main phases: Avoid unique attacks - clones, slams, lightning, marks and meteors
Intermissions: Kill priests and avoid portals and tornadoes
Ascent: jump platforms while harpies try to knock you off, use stability and swiftness or kill them
Labs: destroy the generator and free prisoners, kill the champion rabbit first
Laser stairs: dodge or reflect beams and activate switches at the end if others struggle
Old Tom:  just burst him down or turn on fans to clear poison clouds if it is taking long
Final room: kill four golems, watch your positive/negative charge debuff and stand next to players matching yours

Entry: use pressure plates on either side of the main walkway to open gates, once inside 2 players press on plates letting the previous pressers in. One player must activate the control panel in the back while others distract enemies
You'll randomly have the right or left path open for this next part
Right wing: stealth and carry bombs through detection fields to blow doors
Left wing: carry the mining laser to break walls and dodge AoE patterns
Champion - Rabsovich: Just kill him, then run all the way to the final boss ignoring adds
Final boss: Lure it under the fire buckets, one player goes up and drops the bucket on him, burst it down while vulnerable
Escort: Hug the right wall to get to Siegemaster Dulfy and kill her and break in the gate, killing adds during this phase helps your survivability
City push: The path is different each day, look for which path doesn't have sandbags - make your way to the destroyable gate
Ritual: defend the summoning NPC against waves - they spawn clockwise around the room
Boss - Captain Ashym: avoid large AoEs, nothing too special
Caves: fight grawl waves and sprint the corridor while avoiding rolling fireballs
Shaman barrier: break its bubble by throwing the rocks on the ground at it, stand under shaman to lure it down once the bubble is broken, Shaman leaves at 25% health
Boss - Legendary Imbued Shaman: keep moving on the lava platform to avoid a debuff, avoid rising lava pools on the ground
Every 25% the boss gains a shield that breaks after 40 hits, use quick attacks to break it down
Boss 1 - MAMA: break bar to stop spin, dodge orbs, step out of poison, stack in safe zone for the nuke
Interlude: capture circles while avoiding red orbs, collect blue orbs for healing and cleansing, capture outer circles and kill adds before inner
Boss 2 - Siax: break bar quickly to avoid nuke, point orange cones away from team, poison puddle drops on furthest player - keep them away from team

Boss 3 - Ensolyss: Break bar to avoid nuke, stand behind boss and avoid room wide charges and cones

If bubble forms, stand in it to avoid nuke

66/33% capture circles, dodging red orbs and jumping shockwaves - all downed players resurrect once points are captured

15% poison covers most of the arena, stay in safe area

cm_mechanics.text:
MAMA: assault knights spawn before fight casting near and far AoE attacks you should dodge - can /gg after killing them to buff before boss

At 25% becomes invulnerable and spawns another assault knight to kill
Capture points: more adds - clear them first, then cap

Siax: More adds spawn

66% adds spawn at NSEW and need to be killed, common to mark minimap of which add you will kill

33% same adds spawn but have shifted clockwise slightly, make sure to still grab your add
Ensolyss: Boss will now also do a slam attack that you should dodge inward on to avoid the smash and resulting shockwave, then outward to avoid the followup hallucination attacks

mechanics.text:
Boss 1 - Skorvald: avoid cone kicks and eruptions

Position character to look away when boss has an Eye above it's head

66%/33% glide into rifts to kill flux anomalies around edges

Ball Puzzle: Entering the next area you have Hypernova Launch special action key to dash quickly; enter the left portal, then traverse the islands killing enemies, one island requires using Hypernova Launch to juggle balls to progress

Boss 2 - Artsariiv: Use Hypernova Launch to land on her platform

Kill her clones at 66%/33%, dodge or Hypernova Launch to dodge shockwaves

66% must juggle balls like you did on the islands

Red skull over head (Corporeal Reassignment) means run into the center bubble

Boss 3 - Arkk: push Solar Blooms clockwise into reactors at 100/80/50/30% using attacks, use Nova Launch special action key to avoid projectiles

When boss has an orb over head prepare to use Hypernova Launch to dodge shockwave after it disappears

When boss has an eye over head, position your character to look away
In T4 only at 40% health: platforms vanish - glide to sides, kill anomalies and regroup

cm_mechanics.text:
Skorvald: More frequently casts normal mode attacks, starts with a breakbar

If bomb over your head, leave group and dodge final explosion

Dodge charging attacks at 66%

Enrage at 33% with line eruption knockbacks - stay close and dodge, stability is clutch

Artsariiv: Now has more AoE size on most attacks and clones spawned, and the Eye mechanic is added

Must kill Temporal Anomaly quickly to spawn bubble in middle

Arkk: Starts with Eye mechanic, must still kill Temporal Anomaly to get the bubble to protect from skull

70% an add spawns and Arkk teleports to outer area to cast Eye attack, look away

40% platforms begin to fall then get launched, if you do use Hypernova Launch to land back on platform

mechanics.text: Entrance: Pick up lightning orbs to gain stacks of Charged Leap, enhancing your jump to boost you higher
Mini-Boss - Voice of the Mountain: Dodge AoEs, at 66% and 33% collect 3 orbs and use Charged Leap on the up arrow circles to destroy clouds
Waterfalls: wait for flow of water to slow to move forward

Water Elemental: Destroy boulders to free the elemental

Occasionally a dark orb tethers to a player, stand between them to take over so no player gets 10 stacks
Mini-Boss - Fury of the Mountain: DPS boss, when meteorites drop position yourself to avoid impact and jump over their shockwaves; 66% and lower meteorites follow players briefly before dropping

Final Boss - Sorrowful Spellcaster: Air phase - 100%-66% - Dodge and spread for AoEs, CC break bar quickly to stop her attacks

When boss goes invulnerable and summons clouds, use Charged Leap to destroy them
66% Fire phase: Boss summons 8 meteorites to kick off this phase, dodge them then stand behind one of the final 4 to fall to protect from AoE blast
33% Water phase: Dark orbs spawn be sure to share tether, players also targeted by green AoEs they must share
Water split phase: Boss will rise to the air and you are pushed to the edges - need to walk with your team back to the center, sharing green circles
Can place a portal in the center when water split phase starts to trivialize the mechanic

cm_mechanics.text: You will now go straight to the final fight - Ai, Keeper of the Peak, where you will kill her twice in a Light and Dark phase
Light Phase - 100%-1%: Same phases as normal mode, just with more frequency and urgency. Note only two safe final meteorites spawn at 66%
Dark Phase - 100%-1%: You can safely /gg after killing Light Phase as there is a checkpoint. Ai's attacks now apply Fear and Confusion - condi cleanse is crucial
Fear Phase - 100%-66%: Dodge AoEs and damage the boss. If not at phased by two minutes, Fear enemies spawn and must be kited while DPSing
66% Sorrow Phase: Boss will spawn adds that needs to be focus CCd, Fears continue to spawn
33% Guilt Phase: A Guilt enemy tethers to a player and the player must be shared, ensure to not let it tether to boss or she buffs, multiple Sorrows spawn at once now

mechanics.text: Traversal: use Survey Gear to grapple and glide between platforms
Mini-boss - Dolus: turn away when an eye appears over his head (Dread Visage) and spread for when roman numeral is over player heads (Frightening Speed)
Boss - Kanaxai: look away from eyes, drop axes on the edge and spread numbered marks
Break bar every 10% to prevent aspect spawns, then grapple to visible aspects to kill them
At 66/33%: use Survey Gear to kill tethered aspects quickly before World Cleaver AoE casts - if out of gear charges collect blue orbs from around the main arena to recharge

cm_mechanics.text: Mini-boss - Dolus: Now immediately casts Dread Visage, don't be looking when he spawns
Boss - Kanaxai: From 66% and lower, he will teleport to a random island during Dread Visage you must not be looking at. Easy strat is to just look east since there is no island
33% and lower: He will cast Dread Visage during roman numeral attack, be sure you are looking away during it

mechanics.text: First few rooms: solve orb puzzles to cleanse Astral nodes while other players fending off spawning enemies
Duo fight - Cerus & Deimos: try to keep them apart (strong groups can stack and cleave them together) and avoid stepping in red ground AoE (oils), quickly kill clones that spawn

Final Boss - Eparch: Main mechanic is collecting orbs to prevent him from self-buffing during breakbar phase, prioritize these - either have an orb collector or collect orbs appropriate for your build - listed below

Red (Rage): Spawned by Shockwave attack. If picked up, player +Damage dealt, +Damage taken. If Eparch absorbs, he hits harder.

Green (Envy): Arrow wave attack. +Condi & boon duration. Eparch corrupts boons. These are the most important to pick up as boon corrupt can wipe runs!

Blue (Despair): Fountain attack. -Damage dealt/taken. Eparch takes less damage. Ideally a support takes these.

Purple (Malice): Shard target AoE. +CC power, adds self-conds. Eparch inflicts extra condis.

Orange (Gluttony): Vacuum pull. Heals you initially but hurts over time. Eparch heals himself.
Jump over shockwaves, run out when boss vacuums, dodge through arrow wave, dodge fountain projectiles, If targeted by red circle shards keep away from group
Quickly CC breakbar when it shows up, during it Eparch absorbs orbs on ground and orb buffs players have picked up

cm_mechanics.text: Orb puzzles are harder in CM, so an advanced tactic (bug?) for the orb puzzles is to dodge backward + press interact quickly - prevents the adds from spawning. Alternatively use stealth or stability
Duo fight: Closest player gets fixated, essential to keep them separated as they get a buff together

Picking up your correct color orb is now extremely critical since the stacks no longer fall off. Make sure you CC his breakbar quickly to keep your buffs high. Possibly swap rage grabber at 20 stacks since the damage taken can get intense.
66% and 33%: Champion adds spawn from two rifts, split focus them down

mechanics.text: Exploration: Some doors require players give up their Life Fire (circle that protects from the environment) to open, stay together to protect players without it
Adds are simple throughout, focus down smaller adds first then big ones if available
Final Boss - Frost Tyrant: Two random players have Life Fire, stick together to share with group
Break defiance bar quickly at 75/50/25% or someone's Life Fire will be snuffed
Avoid Freezing Vortex swirls, arrows coming from boss, half room AoEs, and run out if you get a target marker over your head

Boss spins and small red circles appear around the room (Cryoflash): If the circle has an up arrow above it - go inside it, if the small circle has an X, don't stand in them. These alternate every cast

cm_mechanics.text: Resource stealers appear throughout the fractal: CC Frost Wisps to restore Life-Fire they've taken
Final Boss: Cryoflash now instantly kills players that fail it
Green circle (Wintry Orb): stack on green player to share damage safely
Hailstorm: player targeted ground AoEs - spread briefly to avoid overlaps

mechanics.text: Split into 4 teams; destroy crystal spawn points, then stack on the last crystal to lure the Claw.
Burn boss to ~50%, then rotate to the opposite cliff for the air phase.
If first burn was strong: break and kill claws; otherwise stack on right side and ranged the head.
Avoid icicles, breath, and ground spikes; stability/aegis helps against pushbacks.
Divide into West (largest), North, East, Middle (smallest) to defend batteries + Megalaser.
First 25%: stack at left paw and burst; remaining burns at right paw after each defend phase.
Hylek Turrets: skill 1 strips protection stacks (prevents invuln), skill 3 clears poison fields.
Defend tips: West reflect fingers; North stomp wurm nodes; East control creepers; Laser kill champs.
Capture and defend the 4 settlements (Pride Point, Kiel's Outpost, Camp Karka, Steampipe Steading).
When Queen spawns, dodge rolling charge (heavy damage + chain knockdowns).
After first HP bar depletes she refills to 50%-burn second bar to finish.
Form 3 squads with commanders (Amber largest). Finish each head's escort/pre-events, then expose and decap all three heads within seconds.

AMBER - Abomination/Harpoons: Kill a Plague Carrier Abomination to get marked, stack at the red arrow to be eaten, grab harpoons inside, and fire at the wurm when it surfaces. Reflect egg spit and cleave husks/eggs.
COBALT - Keg Delivery: Pick up Unstable Powder Kegs (beach/wreck/platform spawns) and place them on the dark patch with the red arrow in front of the wurm. After ~20 kegs, break the bar and burst.
CRIMSON - Color Extractors: Collect red/blue/yellow phytotoxin clouds and deposit into the matching extractors (≈30 each) to remove Slick Skin; when the head falls, DPS and dodge the slam.
Adds: Kill husks and eggs immediately to prevent healing and AoE pressure on your squad.
Sync Kill: All heads must die together. If your wurm exposes early, stop DPS and hold until the global 'push/decap' call.
5 lanes (I-V), 10 players per lane. Active lane team enters platform; others defend adds.
Kill platform boss then destroy Power Regulator immediately (or lane counts as a failure).
Each boss has unique mechanics (bars, mines, positioning); use Special Action to boon/rez other lanes.
3+ lane failures charges Scarlet's laser to 100% → wipe.
Chase the Anomaly; break defiance to pin it.
Kill Elite/Champion Coalescences to remove damage reduction, then burst boss (usually one phase).
If it escapes, repeat chase → breakbar → add clear.
Only 1 of 5 bosses needs to die for success; prioritize faster encounters.
Wyvern Matriarch: break bar to stop breath, then burst.
Axemaster Gwyllion / Mordrem Tetrad: break bars to stop knockbacks, then DPS.
Cotoni & Huetzi: when one ports to fountain, break bar to stop heals; kill both.
Wyvern Patriarch: long fight; glide/throw eggs to strip invuln-do last if needed.
Split North/West/South/East; East gets fewest (others can assist later).
Use Exalted Armor to stun/clear lane threats quickly (breachers, elites).
South: push explosive via CC into Octovine; West: mushroom glide spore throw; North: deploy & fire turret; East: bomb from updraft.
Kill all 4 Octovines within 2 minutes of first kill-hold DPS if needed.
Split to 4 lanes (Nuhoch strongest). Complete lane pre-events to extend burn time.
Break bars often; avoid expanding purple AoEs; burn before burrow reset.
Kill all four Gerents; then loot Ley-Line Confluence and optional treasure room.
Escort Miner Mikhail; split ~10 per drill to defend 3 drills during the walk.
Oil collection: grab bucket from pump, collect nearby puddles, deposit until each drill is filled.
Boss Sulypix: jump/dodge shockwaves; stay mobile vs charges and slicks; branding adds can be mostly ignored.
Collect Casino Coins across Amnoon over 3 rounds; mounts recommended.
Deal with Mischievous Children/Troublemakers to avoid slows/interrupts.
Boss: break Piñata's bar immediately to stop hopping, then burst.
Escort Kaidenna; then inside Augury Rock, kill 4 Branded Elementals to drop boss shield.
Champion Josso Essher: break bar on spawn/whenever up; kill Elemental adds that re-shield him.
After kill: disperse wild magic quickly; then defeat the Doppelganger (spawned via red skull marker).
Collect Sulfur Crystals to charge lures (3 per event for full credit). Tag all 3 if possible.
Kill Awakened/Forged Commanders-keep them from being knocked into protected areas.
Destroy 3 Forged cannons (south) and 3 Awakened trebuchets (north); loot spawned chests.
Revive and escort the Awakened Commander; in the inner chamber, break bars on 4 Priests then kill.
Destroy 3 Cannonades, kill Champion Commander; then fight Tegon & Temar-alternate until 50%, then together.
Avoid hounds' pull + burning vortex; stability/cleanse helps; Medizooka can sustain group.
Breach gates by killing Khepri & Khnum; capture north, kill temple elites, destroy Joko statue.
Capture south; at docks, board two Corsair ships (or use shore cannons) and destroy them.
Boss Iberu: break bar ~75%; kill tethered Servants to stop heals; burst to finish.
Optional DERV escort for allies; engage Shatterer and break bars to reduce pressure.
At 75/50/25% kill Riftstalkers fast (25% on floating rocks via updrafts) to prevent boss heals.
High DPS can skip some adds, but risky-Riftstalkers heal the boss if ignored.
Kill Champion Flame Elemental to start the ritual and create Sacred Flame.
Torch relay up the cliff: light → run to next brazier; throw to another player if flame is expiring.
Portaling forward with a lit torch extinguishes it; use portals only to return for fresh torches.
Ignite and kill the Effigy; then defeat the Champion Devourers for bonus loot.
Escort Shaman Brightblaze to the ruins (give swiftness; stay close enough that the NPC receives boons).
At shrine: defend vs ghosts, kill Steward, then fight Murakai-break bar whenever up.
At 75% Murakai tethers to ghostly echoes-find and kill tethers to remove her invuln.
Split into Ash/Blood/Iron trial groups and clear all trial sub-events quickly.
Ash: carry oil buckets to central vent; Blood: take color buff to capture points/kill matching oozes; Iron: plug vents and kill oozes.
Grand Ooze: at ~75% and ~25% goes invuln; grab poison color buff to damage, then kill 3 split oozes (red/green/blue).
Escort Jhavi if active; during fight hide behind terrain or use aegis/stab to counter howls.
When bar appears, break it to open Raven Gate; assigned team kills champion inside (Spiritual Binding prevents re-entry).
Repeat bar → gate → champion at 60/40/20%; use Mesmer/Thief portals to help later phases.
Secure North/South, defeat Ryland & Braham opens main fight.
Cycles: destroy Ley Siphons → break Clashing Champions → split DPS on both dragons (keep even).
Specials: dodge Jormag frost beam; stay with Braham + jump shockwaves; always break bars.
Finale: launch via prisms; use Special Action beams; break final bar; channel to Aurene.
Talk to Fahd al'Eshadhi to start; find the Leviathan in the orange ring.
Remove Thick Skin: Skiff Depth Charge (skill 4) or get swallowed and hit weak point (uvula) from inside.
Kaineng swims deeper (swallow method easier); Seitung surfaces more (even stand on back briefly).
Split East/Middle/West (East hardest). Phase 1: stop looters; return dropped supply to depot.
Phase 2: each lane destroys 3 cannons-break shield (bar) then DPS; kill Elite Thugs.
Phase 3: defeat lane bosses; regroup for Captain Renyak. Kill Champion Bulwark Gyros during invuln and break bars at 66/33/1%.
Stabilize at least one Power Zone before start (keeps a safe waypoint).
Defend North & South Xunlai Jade Labs; kill sword-marked priority enemies.
Escort repair crews; defend 3 breaker boxes + substations on each route.
Jade Behemoth: at each 25% becomes invuln-kill Power Replicators + Jade Swarmers to re-expose.
Use Siege Turtle/Remote Charges to destroy exterior shield generators.
Split NW/SE; defeat champions; destroy inner generators; escort allies to inner gate.
Gods' Vengeance superweapon: avoid rotating flame wall (lethal); choose to farm champion mechs or hard-focus boss.
Stage 1: defend Kropa; help Cyclow with turtle shields; send 1-2 to stop Speaker ritual at Altrumm Mines.
Stage 2 (3 villages): Goa defuse mines (repeat symbol sequence); Kardast scan/reveal spies; Teleri break crystals then kill Ritualists.
Stage 3: split at Junkyard to stop both gangs; then kill In-Sook & Noori roughly together.
Final: Prototype XJ-1-at ~60% hide behind junk piles during lethal clap after double slam.
Preparation (30m): stack Contributor (aim 10) and map readiness; organize subgroups with quickness/alacrity.
Triple Escorts: West/Central/East; break mid Saltspray bars ~70% and finish; capture outposts to deploy turtles.
Turtle phase: turtle cannons destroy 3 Void shields; then kill spawned Saltspray (break bar).
Cleanse 4 corrupted areas + Harvest Complex (collect orbs → spawn/kill champion at each).
Charge 5 prismatic crystals with colored orbs-finish all within ~5 minutes (extensions per crystal).
Soo-Won: split at 60% (2 ways) and 20% (3 ways); avoid lethal AoEs; use Special Actions as prompted; coordinate even DPS.
Stage 1: Gather sky essences around Droknar's Light quickly (use flying mounts; 5-min timer).
Stage 2: Split to the five outer islands and collect/kill to fill essence bars.
Stage 3 (Droknar's Forge): keep three colored bars up-kill sparks and collect matching essences when a color dips.
Final platform: assign center defenders for 3 Memory Snares (keep zones blue, reset if corrupted) and outer teams on skyscales.
Charge snares at outer platforms (kill to charge) → return and Special-Action the snares; repeat, then sync-kill 3 Invaders and purge Lyhr to finish.
Clear Tentacles at each Bastion - kill the Kryptis champion, then close rifts with Heart of the Obscure.
Take the portal to Bastion of the Celestial; split to 3 rifts and close them fast.
World Spire: kill 4 tentacles; grab special action key from white circles to strip Reinforced Armor; dodge beams/balls.
After first burn, evacuate at 50% (Growing Anxiety) and regroup on outer ring.
Summon Guardians: defend companions and mount skyscales to collect floating orbs; rotate between defending and collecting.
Finale: repeat tentacles → DPS Nourys; then stand in circles and mirror Dagda's poses, lastly skyscale fireball the Eyes to end it.
Lead-up: defend allies and escort troops through Nayos, closing rifts and defeating Kryptis champions in each area before reaching Eparch's lair.
Siege Zakiros: use your Skyscale to drop bombs on pylons to clear the malignant fog, then destroy extractor towers with thrown bombs.
Defeat Gatekeeper Vialgos to enter the twin spires; allied forces split between Spire of Redemption and Spire of Creation.
In Spire of Redemption: descend, free prisoners, and defeat Karax the Harvester. In Spire of Creation: descend, clear abyssal watchers, and defeat Charybda the Cunning.
Finale - Defeat Eparch, the Consumed King: focus adds and close rifts fast; open rifts give him barrier and stacking damage/healing buffs.
Grab buff pools: Swords boost power DPS, Fists boost condi DPS, and the green skull grants heavy life-leech sustain.
Players sent to the shadow realm should avoid AoEs and cleanse the damage debuff at fountains on arena edges after returning.
At ~20% HP, clear remaining rifts quickly, then burn Eparch while cleaving adds. If multiple rifts are active, focus them first to prevent buff stacking.
If downed or dead, use ley-lines near the emergency waypoint to glide back into the arena quickly.
Two bosses spawn in different zones (Decima north, Greer south); both must die within 30 seconds or the first revives.
Decima deals power damage; Greer deals condi + boon corruption. Adjust builds accordingly (cleanses, condi defense).
At 75% & 25% HP, each boss becomes invulnerable: break their defiance bar, mount Warclaws, use Chain Pull, run through gates to strip armor, then resume fight.

Mechanics per side: North (Decima) - stand in green lines linking to conduits (block Empowered stacks), avoid red lines; South (Greer) - stack on green circles to prevent AoE corruption, kill add waves in break phases.
During chain phase: mount Warclaws, target boss with Chain Pull, ride around through checkpoint gates to break shield, then dismount and continue normal combat.
Charge Livia's Scepter: defend and assist her to breach the Maw of Saevus with titanspawn energy.
Defeat Lextalion the Merciless: avoid shockwave telegraphs (jump or dodge), kill spirits in prisons quickly, and break his defiance bars at 75/50/25%.
Membrane Phase: the meta splits into North / Center / South lanes. Use Siege Turtle, Skyscale fireballs, or Warclaw chain pulls to destroy membranes protecting the organs.
Organ Assault: destroy nodules and kill shielded champions (they explode) to damage the lungs (north/south) and heart (center). Watch for knockbacks on lungs.
Artillery / Titan Leukocytes: ranged / skyscale fireball kills count for damage contributions in final phase.
Map closes after meta; participating in all lanes is needed for achievements. Full meta completion yields map-meta chest.
Use hard crowd control to break the Hammer Knights' shields as soon as they appear so damage can continue.
At 75%/50%/25% health you gain a polarity (positive or negative)-follow the prompt to the matching boss to keep stacks aligned and avoid retaliation.
When both bosses reach 25% they regroup in the center; stack together, cleave carefully, and keep breakbars controlled to finish the fight.
Phase 1 - Split between the drills. All need to die at the same time.
Stay inside the blue area by your drill to attack, and break the defiance bar when it appears.
Phase 2 - Burn the main boss while dodging rotating lasers; if transformed into a bunny, hop into the floating orbs to strip the defiance bar.
During the illusion split, identify clones with breakbars (including those off the main platform) and CC them to advance the fight.
If pulled through a portal simply glide back to the arena to rejoin the fight.
At 50% three boss adds spawn; kill all three within 30 seconds of each other.
The Forge: split into 3 groups, capture and hold the chambers, then kill each room's champion.
Underwater conduits: keep 3 groups. Use skimmer Aetherlocation to find repair pieces and bring them to the conduits; destroy energy leaks with skimmer attacks.
Return to The Forge: kill Kela's two minions (Australis / Borealis), then destroy the All Seer chains. Take the northern portal to The All Seer.

Use SKIMMER between platforms - other mounts get shot down. Split between 3 avatar platforms, kill each avatar, then CC its feretory (soul container). Regroup in the middle, kill the enhanced creatures, then repeat for the other 3 avatars.
Shackled / yellow screen border: your skill bar changes. Press Dispel Shackle in slots 1-5, not Fumble the Dispel; its position changes after each press. Get 5 correct presses to free yourself.
Start at Hall of Assemblage. Split between Doyen's Adytum / The Auguratorium / Ley Distributary; capture each location's 3 circles, then kill its champion.
Mark III Golem: enter when your rift opens; everyone else defends the rifts and destroys Inquest cannons. Groups get kicked out at 75% / 50%; at 25%, all three rifts open.

Split platforms: WEST (Project 5388) - destroy Mutagenic Chambers to free trapped players before mutations spawn. EAST (Subject Gamma) - stand under the falling red orbs to bounce them and break its huge defiance bar.
After both bosses die, stay to smash the chambers and rescue NPC allies. Then ride the leylines up to the final platform.
Twisted Creation: spread orange sword circles away from friends. After its purple meteor attack or dash, be ready to dodge the sword follow-up.
