66% / 33% / 10%: half stay below to break chambers, free players and kill released Champion Mutations; half ride leylines up to destroy floating debris and break the shield. Keep enough rescuers below before sending more players up.
Start by opening coffins until the Champion Gate Guardian spawns, then kill it to begin the route
Trap hallway: wait for red circles to fade, then place a boulder on the pedestal to open the gate
Ralena and Vassar: keep them separated or CC them apart so they do not empower each other
Kasha and Nente: use the pedestal stone for Kasha and climb the plank carefully to reach Nente
King Adelbern: keep moving out of Foefire and sword fire fields during the final fight
Shared start: clear Spider Queen pressure by killing spiders and gargoyle heads, then run trap halls only after red circles fade
Hodgins defense: destroy six burrows with strike damage and keep gravelings off Hodgins
Scepter pieces: use Show Interactable Objects and mobility to grab pieces instead of fighting every graveling
Howling King: do not stand in front of screams and lure boss or adds through fire rings for extra damage
Shared start: clear Spider Queen pressure, then pull the chain at the end of the trap hallway
Detha defense: trigger pillar traps to kill gravelings and keep Detha alive until setup finishes
Ghost room: kill ghosts before they reach Detha while she prepares the weapons
Ghost Eater: lure boss onto a trap, use ghost guns to raise ectoplasms into it, then burst while vulnerable
Shared start: clear Spider Queen pressure, disable traps, and skip or kill Kohler depending on group comfort
Essence collectors: kill burrows first with strike damage, then clean up gravelings attacking collectors
Northern chamber: destroy all graveling burrows with strike damage before moving to Rumblus
Colossus Rumblus: avoid frontal screams, pull him away from falling ceiling zones, and dodge or stun break if caught
Party event: talk to nobles and pick gossip responses to progress the opening
Manor route: kill the golem and door guard, then move into the basement
Basement: wake Sigfast by throwing the water bucket on him, then continue the escort
Final courtyard: clear the outside bosses and use line of sight or reflects against bandit rifle pressure
Traffa must follow you and interact with every Asuran Technology object in the basement
Barn and cave: use line of sight or reflects against snipers, or stop moving while being shot
Bandit pulls: use terrain to group enemies and avoid sniper lines before moving deeper
Frost: dodge ice spike shots or you are frozen, and stand behind him to avoid the frontal chill cone
Rosalina's Satchel: stand on rugs and throw pillows across spike traps to cross the room safely
Gate keg event: carry kegs from the supply pile to all five red circles at the gate
Bandits steal kegs back to the pile, CC them and use mobility or weapon swap drops to finish faster
Turmaine: when he enters plague form, stop attacking, split up, and run away from pulsing damage and conditions
Rocket turret cave: grab rifles and use any rifle skill as rockets arrive to reflect them into turrets
Only the environmental rifle reflect damages turrets reliably, other reflects can protect but will not progress as fast
Sniper sections: use terrain and line of sight to group bandits instead of fighting in open angles
Vallog: stop using projectiles while swirling winds are active or they will reflect back at you
Avoid randomly opening nightmare blooms because hostile blooms spawn extra enemies
Lake of Fear: collect bridge pieces from the water, nearby corner, and fern hound area
Blighted husk: kill courtiers inside blooms and throw the dropped orbs to remove invulnerability
Faolain illusions: kill illusions close together and pressure or CC Faolain to stop revives
Volatile blooms create poison clouds, kill or avoid them as you move through toxic flora
Spider rooms: pull groups carefully, avoid eggs, and respect petrify pressure
Malrona: stand behind her poison cone, then dodge or outrange the poison projectile volley
Nightmare Tree: keep moving from seed pod projectiles and dodge the hand-lift ground smash
Volatile blooms create poison clouds, kill them for safety and possible rally value
Bubble room: enter side portals to reach courtiers inside protective bubbles, or block through bubbles
Bridge and spiders: keep distance from petrifying spiders and clear blooms while moving
Nightmare Tree: cleave extra trees that immobilize players and dodge the hand-lift ground smash
Ooze maze: two players lure oozes with the plant buff while others CC or reflect lava elementals without killing oozes
Sparki and Slick: damage both evenly so they die together, clean oil with the blue-heart ooze, and avoid lighting oil fields
Generators: kill holographic aetherblades near generators to damage them, but avoid stacking too many explosions
Shock floor puzzle requires four players on final pedestals, move the hologram to the door and kill it there
Clockheart: kill holograms on top of the boss to strip resistance stacks, dodge cogs and the raised-hand slam
Scaffolding and golem: pull the chain after the Inquest boss, stay out of the golem aura, and avoid projectile reflects
Gate winch: carry three gears through falling workplace hazards while ignoring unnecessary respawns
Zojja gate event: protect and revive Zojja while she opens the gate, progress continues after revives
Kudu and golems: bring cleanse, stun breaks, and stability while avoiding projectiles and ground hazards
Iron Forgeman: kill lava elementals for rocks, throw rocks at boss, and swap between hiding behind plates or leaving them based on the lava attack
Destroy Barrier Turrets to remove force fields and progress through the siege route
Trap gauntlet: keep moving through trap triggers and avoid golem pulls that drag players into explosions
Three golems: line of sight them together, bring reflects, and cleanse conditions
Tazza: pull her away from other champions, kill clones, and dodge her red-circle burst
Break the bridge barrier, pull the gate chain, defeat foremen, and protect Tarleov
Taskmaster: lure him under falling machinery to break his shield before damaging him
Ore collection: bring glowing ore back to Rasolov before starting the final encounter
War Minister Shukov: use large AoE for dredge and mining suits, then damage Mark I and Mark II evenly or they reset
Break the first barrier and dredge boss, then bypass the bridge elites by breaking the lower barrier
Molradovich: step onto water pumps when a fire ring forms around you to cleanse it
Dredge carrier: only strike damage works, use projectile reflects and survive waves while burning it down
Destroyer of Worlds: kill destroyers and avoid fire fields on the ground
Opening: kill bosses and braziers to cross the bridge, and avoid bridge knockbacks
Flame Legion boss: keep moving so imp explosions do not stack on you
Effigy: sustain through the pulsing fire aura and attack brazier enemies when their bubbles drop
Gaheron: stay in Logan's bubble, dodge boulders and meteors, then throw broken boulder shards until he shrinks
Later Gaheron phases: break fiery stalagmites so thrown shards can reach him again
Crea Irontooth event: kill sword-marked acolytes first so they respawn and progress the event faster
Boulder puzzle: use Enkindlers to cross safely and light three ritual bowls within a short window
Brazier puzzle: four players stand in braziers while another player or pet clears the last brazier inside
Final boss: avoid falling shards and dodge the large red-circle attack
Devourer hatchery: destroy burrows with strike damage first, then pull shaman-room chains and kill the Prison Warden
Bomb run: bring all bombs back to Magg before the two-minute timer expires, using mobility or portals
Oracite escort: use guns to clear fire from the ground and kill oozes that immobilize Magg
Bomb setup defense: watch for barely visible stealth assassins walking toward Magg and kill them first
Eternal Flame: kill all four corner acolytes together, then burn the flame before any acolyte respawns
Claw puzzle needs three players channeling separate Claws of Baelfire within seconds of each other
Protect channelers from nearby mobs or use stealth because interrupts force the puzzle to restart
Bomb hallway: wait for bombs to light then dim, then move quickly before the explosions catch up
Tribune Burntclaw: dodge toward him during the slow outward earth shockwave
Opening: attack the Ice Spike from range, kill icebrood for pressure, and avoid frost shards
Mid bosses: avoid Kulag ice fields, kite Hirvela if needed, and keep moving from Lani's ice spike chain
Beacon room: light beacons to defrost the ice wall and use pillars to block chilling projectiles
Honor's Voice: break allies out of ice blocks with damage because stun breaks do not free them
Kodan's Bane: kill the pet once, avoid vomit and melee pressure, and line of sight warhorn birds
Take out ice turrets to open the next door
Icebrood Troll: dodge toward it when it leaps and cleanse fear or weakness
Aldus Stormbringer: strip protection stacks with fast hits before damaging him
Ice hallway: wait out red-circle explosions, use the side safe spot, then pull the door chain
Ginva the Butcher: avoid whirling axes and strip or cleave protection totems when practical
Torn Fur room: lure the icebrood pack to stairs instead of fighting ranged seers in the open
Svanir bosses: sidestep charge attacks and avoid standing in ice fields
Underwater route: use good underwater weapons, skip optional enemies, and kill the final ice wall
Wollam the Plunderer: dodge charge attacks sideways and kite away if targeted
Take out ice turrets, kill the bridge icebrood, then fight Svanigandr carefully through fast hits
Fimbul: CC him when he turns into an ice block to stop the heal
Underwater route: bring good underwater weapons and swim through fish and icebrood to the final boss
Sorge the Zealot: keep healing available because underwater attack tells are hard to read
Inquest route: use walls to line of sight enemies, interrupt Subversion Specialist stun beams, and bring stun breaks
Experiment room: destroy consoles first with strike damage so fewer experiments break free
Control nexus: protect Zojja while she shuts it down, kill clockwise spawns quickly, and revive her if needed
Mr. Sparkles escort: stand inside his radiation-safe area and use Resonance Rifle skills to stop sparks
Kudu: avoid static fields, line of sight the unblockable rifle kill shot, then dodge monster ground attacks and claws
Subject Alpha: stay in melee and dodge when attacks land, not early or late
Laser puzzle requires four console interactions at once, get two players across lasers and leave two behind
Control nexus: channel the alarm console five times while others kill exploding golems before interrupts
Bjarl the Rampager: stand away and bait his shielded charge into pillars to make him vulnerable
Final Alpha: keep melee stack discipline and revive or break allies free quickly
Subject Alpha: stay in melee and dodge on impact timing instead of kiting him around
Laser puzzle requires four console interactions at once, get two players across lasers and leave two behind
Golem and cannon rooms: kill protection turrets with strike damage and defend the cannon from small golems
Evolved Husk: avoid standing next to it, use rifles to knock unstable golems onto the boss, and bring cleanse
Final Alpha: maintain melee stack and dodge timing through the last repeat
Subject Alpha: stay in melee and dodge on impact timing instead of kiting him around
Laser puzzle requires four console interactions at once, get two players across lasers and leave two behind
Golem and cannon rooms: kill protection turrets with strike damage and defend the cannon from small golems
Evolved Destroyer: channel three cannons at the same time to strip shield, but bait Dragon's Tooth away before channeling
Destroyer burn: jump to the lava-pit center and damage during vulnerability, then repeat cannons when shield returns
Tar Elemental requires four players on the four tar spouts to reveal the boss whenever it sinks
Tar petrifies and slows, apply burning to the boss to convert tar into burning tar instead
Lupicus: dodge grub spawns, kill grubs before he eats them, reflect or dodge poison volleys, and stun break out of bubbles
Jotun Stargazer: grab reflecting crystals or use reflects to send his high-damage projectile back
Operative Belka: stand in melee or use reflects to avoid the large spark projectile, and dodge when she ports
Abomination: kill Inquest for rifles, then use rifles to pacify it when it enrages
Lupicus: dodge grub spawns, kill grubs before he eats them, reflect or dodge poison volleys, and stun break out of bubbles
Minefield and undead: avoid mines, focus deadeyes and sentinels, and use line of sight for dangerous packs
Operative Brie: protect the terminal from undead until 50%, avoid frontal beams and sparks, then finish her fast
Crusher and Hunter: stay beside or behind Crusher, cleanse Hunter poison and immobilize, and do not kite Crusher far away
Light puzzle: carry charge between hanging orbs, heal through damage, and throw charge to teammates or use portals
Lupicus: dodge grub spawns, kill grubs before he eats them, reflect or dodge poison volleys, and stun break out of bubbles
Risen Wraith event: capture rings by having more players than enemies inside, then kill Wraithlord once vulnerable
Balthazar and Melandru: light torches with hound orbs, pour poison buckets on tree stumps, then avoid whirl and corrupted lights
Lyssa: kill clones, then cleanse or wait out heavy confusion before attacking again
Light puzzle: carry charge between hanging orbs twice, heal through damage, throw to teammates, or use portals
Lupicus: dodge grub spawns, kill grubs before he eats them, reflect or dodge poison volleys, and stun break out of bubbles
Grenth: split to five marks, tag the rotating wraith quickly, then kill marked wraiths or revive downed allies
Dwayna and Bloodstone Shard: use Dwayna's Tears to prevent or cleanse petrify, lure sparks to slots at 50%, then stack and burn

The Path to Ascension: Augury Rock
